question: For the declared finite zero-source Q3 regulators, does the n-weighted truncated-CCR top tail remain finite for both cutoff orientations along a positive-time vacuum history and in the uncut Gibbs state?

model.cutoff: H_L is formed by replacing every coordinate q_x in the bond terms by the smooth spectral cutoff q_L; W_L=H-H_L
model.history: psi_{sigma,t}=exp(-i t (H+sigma W_L)/hbar) vacuum for sigma in {-1,+1} and declared nonnegative times
model.top_projector: P_top,j is the oscillator-level n-1 projector at site j
model.weighted_tail: n^2 <psi,P_top,j psi> and n^2 Tr(rho P_top,j)

lean_crosscheck.boundary: R277 checks only natural-number weighted top-defect fixtures and the two-orientation count; it does not formalize matrix exponentials, Gibbs traces, Q3 domains, or a QFT limit.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite Q3 tail checkpoint. It records finite Gibbs and evolved-history weighted top-tail values for a declared regulator family only; it does not establish a regulator-, volume-, source-, orientation-, or history-uniform estimate.
no_overclaim: Finite weighted tails and a Lean arithmetic fixture do not justify the unbounded common-core transfer, modular-history Cauchy estimate, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, or Pre-A closure.
